request.input:

Hospital note: "5 units O-negative for ruptured ectopic pregnancy, patient O-negative, in shock."
Candidate bank: Government Teaching General Hospital Blood Centre, Rajahmundry.
Group that would be dispensed: O- (exact match).
O- units at this bank now: 6. Units remaining after this dispatch: 1.
Units of O- already requested by pending orders at this bank: 6.
Pending orders at this bank for O-: 6u O-: Trauma theatre now: 24M road-traffic polytrauma with splenic rupture, typed O-negative, haemodynamically unstable. Massive transfusion protocol on standby; all 6 O-neg units earmarked for this patient.
